metadata.description: Open tools from Madrona Product Studio — reusable Claude Code skills for building and shipping polished product.

plugins.name: operating-system
plugins.description: An open, forkable operating system: a plain-text source of truth you own + the agent routines that keep it current on a rhythm. You own the mind; a surface just renders it.

plugins.name: animation-vocabulary
plugins.description: Turn a vague description of a motion effect into its exact term ("the bouncy thing when a popover opens" → Pop in).

plugins.name: motion-options
plugins.description: Build 3–4 genuinely distinct motion options, compare them live side by side, pick, wire the winner in, tear the harness down.

plugins.name: og-image
plugins.description: Design and wire great Open Graph / social-share images following a "simple is best" doctrine.

plugins.name: screenshot
plugins.description: A tiny Playwright screenshotter for visual QA — full-page or by selector, retina-aware, capped for AI image limits.

plugins.name: investor-ready
plugins.description: Audit and fix an app so a first-time outsider gets what it is and sees the core value fast — first-run messaging, a demo wow-path, credibility polish, plus bundled scripts (OG image, icons, production audit).

plugins.name: gtm-sweep
plugins.description: Take an app to market as a repeatable, measured sweep — positioning, a measurement floor, SEO expansion, channel launch, and a read/iterate loop.

plugins.name: presentable-pass
plugins.description: Pre-share cleanup pass for a web app — footer/attribution, stale AI model names, disclaimers, broken builds, boilerplate, mobile polish, then branch and open a PR.

plugins.name: review-animations
plugins.description: Review motion code against a high craft bar (frequency, easing, duration, physicality, reduced-motion) and return a findings table plus a Block/Approve verdict.
